description: Fixed-server long-horizon Barrier-first primary profile. It requires an optimal primal-dual interior solution, saves a reusable BarX/BarPi checkpoint, skips inline crossover, allows 24 hours of solver time, and retains a 16 GiB host reserve when used behind the 96 GiB full-year memory gate on a 128 GiB server. A planning sequence may explicitly propagate the accepted capacity state; crossover remains a later human-selected derivative.
